name: More to Say Find Angi
canDoWhy: Two ways in: Faendal in Riverwood (or Valdr, near Falkreath) tells you about a dangerous hunter who might teach you archery, or Legate Skulnar wants that same fugitive, Angi, dead.

starts.where: Riverwood; he sleeps in Faendal's House (11 pm for 5 hours) and works around Riverwood from 7 am for 12 hours
starts.how: Talk to him and he tells you about a skilled but dangerous hunter who might train you in Archery.

starts.where: Moss Mother Cavern near Falkreath at first; once his own trouble there is over, he hangs around Dead Man's Drink in Falkreath and sleeps in Valdr's House (10 pm)
starts.how: He can tell you the same tale of the hunter.

starts.where: with the Imperial Legion in Falkreath Hold
starts.how: He asks you to find and kill a dangerous fugitive.

choices.choice: Take Legate Skulnar's job and kill her
choices.leadsTo: Angi dies; report back to Legate Skulnar.

choices.choice: Take Legate Skulnar's job but spare her
choices.leadsTo: You still have to decide what to tell the Legate.

objectives: Train with the seasoned hunter
Kill the seasoned hunter
Kill Angi or tell her you will spare her
Report back to Legate Skulnar

rewards.when: from the quest's script; the records don't say how much or on which path

closes: Angi dies if you kill her, and her training goes with her

people.name: Angi
people.role: the hunter and fugitive; lives at Angi's Camp, sleeps there from 10 pm

people.name: Valdr
people.role: can also tell you about the hunter

people.name: Legate Skulnar
people.role: wants the fugitive dead; you report back to him

unsure.why: The line that hands out Legate Skulnar's job isn't in these files, only his log entry and the 'report back' step; the records give him no placement, only that he is an Imperial field commander for Falkreath Hold.
Angi's Camp isn't in the places index, so its hold comes from the quest being Falkreath's and the log calling Skulnar 'the Falkreath Legate'.
The quest's script holds a gold reward, but which ending pays it, and how much, isn't readable here. The training is from the log, not a script property.
The quest has two endings that complete it and one that fails it; the records don't say which choice leads to the failure.
